# Test fixture provenance

`audio/fake-microphone.wav` is synthetic English speech generated with eSpeak NG
and normalized to mono 48 kHz PCM with FFmpeg. It contains no third-party
recording, human voice, or personal data. It exercises Chrome's native fake
microphone, browser `MediaRecorder`, and large-v3 transcription paths. The
project dedicates this generated fixture under CC0-1.0.
